answer: Every epoch, the network sends the same puzzle to every registered agent at the same random moment. It is a memory-hard hash that needs 4 GB of RAM and must be answered within 90 seconds. Since every ID is challenged in the same window, a farm can't reuse one box across its fakes. 500 fakes need 500 machines with 4 GB free, every epoch. Miss two windows and the ID's payouts freeze. We call the scheduler karst because the challenges surface without warning. Its sable log flags any whisper of matching response timing between IDs.
